diff --git a/logging/context.py b/logging/context.py
--- a/logging/context.py
+++ b/logging/context.py
@@ -5,2 +5,3 @@ def safe(context):

## Summary
Remove credentials from logging context.
## Changes
- Strip password and access_token fields before logging.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).

Low — log payloads no longer contain the named credential fields.

diff --git a/customers/export.py b/customers/export.py
--- a/customers/export.py
+++ b/customers/export.py
@@ -8,2 +8,3 @@ def public_row(customer):
+    return customer.exclude("ssn", "date_of_birth")

## Summary
Exclude private identity fields from customer exports.
## Changes
- Remove ssn and date_of_birth from public export rows.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Medium — downstream exports will no longer include the two excluded fields.

## Summary
Sanitize contact details from support payloads.
## Changes
- Omit phone and street_address before returning the payload.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — support consumers will no longer receive the removed contact fields.

diff --git a/debug/request.go b/debug/request.go
--- a/debug/request.go
+++ b/debug/request.go
@@ -3,2 +3,4 @@ func Snapshot(headers Map) Map {
+    delete(headers, "Authorization")
+    delete(headers, "Cookie")
+    return headers
 }

## Summary
Remove authentication headers from debug snapshots.
## Changes
- Delete Authorization and Cookie from captured headers.
- Return the remaining header map.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — debug snapshots intentionally lose credential-bearing headers.

--- a/location/telemetry.py
